svg.title: What happens to a new fact
svg.desc: Two write paths side by side. The Mem0 paper: an LLM call extracts candidate facts from each pair of messages; code fetches the ten most similar stored facts for each candidate; a second LLM call chooses one of four operations, ADD, UPDATE, DELETE or NOOP, so a contradicted fact can be deleted. The release, mem0ai 2.2.1: code fetches the ten stored facts most similar to the whole session; one LLM call extracts new facts with those ten in view and can only add; code drops exact duplicates by hash and stores the rest. The model's links from a new fact to related stored facts are not stored. In the example, the old fact 'strict vegetarian for eight years' stays in the store next to the new fact 'transitioned from a strict vegetarian diet to a pescatarian diet'.
